acceptanceCriteria: Each other groupreap Owner caller either opts into RepeatKillWhileLive with a spec amendment, or its spec records why a single signal suffices; a fake-host test per opted-in caller fails with the repeat disabled.
body: Found by the #1116 lane (V1-2103, PR #1344). On Darwin a single process-group SIGKILL can miss a process forked at that moment (3 of 300 stops in a local probe). #1344 adds opt-in groupreap.Primitives.RepeatKillWhileLive for the attempt runner only (ATR-V0-153). The other Owner callers (dispatch reader, CEM Git runner, dogfood aggregate worker, Linux service descendants probe) still send one signal as their specs require, so they can leave a survivor and HOLD or report SURVIVORS. Suspected, not reproduced in those callers.
